headline: Somewhere slower.
intro: Space to breathe. A little time for you. We're dreaming of an escape in June 2027.
hero_alt: Turquoise water and rocky cliffs on the Mallorca coast
story_heading: A retreat with room to breathe.
story: Begin the day with movement, gather around the table for food worth slowing down for, then choose what you need next. Explore, read, sleep, swim or talk for hours. The plan gives the day shape without filling every minute. Come with a friend or come alone. Beginners are welcome.
past_heading: Where the journey has taken us
past_description: Alive and Aglow brought our group into the Welsh mountains for generous yoga, long walks, shared food and the rare pleasure of having nowhere else to be.
quote: Vanessa's retreats are very special. She creates such a beautiful environment that gives people flexibility to do whatever they want to do.
interest_description: Leave your details and we'll share the destination, dates and all the lovely details when they're ready.
